input.prompt: Wide night shot: she sprints through the field of tall grass from left to right, legs and arms pumping, hair streaming; the camera pans slowly to follow her. Two hard white flashlight beams sweep across the grass from behind her, and the grass whips in the wind. Anime style, consistent with the first frame, clean cel shading, same character design: same face, same large eyes (same size, never smaller), same long straight black hair, same white cropped jacket with orange bands and patches, black top and trousers; no glasses. Smooth, stable lineart, no morphing, correct hands with five fingers. Single continuous shot, no cuts. No text, no subtitles, no logos.
